finalReport.rawFindings:
--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[CDN-1] Large uploads proxied through Next API
File: src/app/api/upload/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: The POST handler reads the entire uploaded File into memory (await file.arrayBuffer(); Buffer.from(...)) and then calls uploadToR2, proxying the full payload through the Node process. This pattern buffers/streams large files (images up to 100MB, videos up to 500MB) on the origin for every upload.
Impact: Concurrent large uploads will exhaust server memory, CPU and outbound bandwidth and will tie up request handlers, causing origin instability under load.
Fix: Switch to direct-to-storage uploads (presigned PUT/POST URLs or client -> Cloudflare Images/R2 upload) so the browser streams directly to object storage and the origin is not a proxy.

[CDN-2] Large static media in /public served from origin
File: public/video.mp4, public/wpvideo.mp4, public/Order Complete.webm, public/perle images/* (file listing)
Evidence: The repo contains multiple large video files and many high-resolution JPG/HEIC images in /public; these are served as static assets (no assetPrefix/CDN enforced in next.config). If not fronted by a CDN, those bytes hit the origin on every request.
Impact: High-traffic downloads (videos, hero images) will quickly saturate origin bandwidth and slow or break delivery for other users.
Fix: Host large media in object storage behind a CDN (Cloudflare Images/Cloudflare CDN, R2 with CDN, or Vercel asset CDN) and serve optimized/responsive variants rather than raw public files.

[CDN-3] R2 listing endpoints hit origin and R2 on every request
File: src/app/api/admin/storage/images/route.ts (L1-L120)
Evidence: The admin GET calls listImages() -> listStorageItems(), which runs ListObjectsV2 against R2 on each request and returns JSON with no cache-control headers; there is no caching or CDN layer guarding repeated list calls.
Impact: Frequent hits (even from UI polling or public access) will generate heavy R2 List API traffic, increase origin latency/costs, and can overload the server when many clients request listings concurrently.
Fix: Cache listing results (s-maxage/stale-while-revalidate or edge CDN cache) and paginate/limit results; avoid calling ListObjects on every request from the origin.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[CDN-4] Cart API uses very short private TTL
File: src/app/api/cart/route.ts (L1-L220)
Evidence: The GET cart response sets Cache-Control: "private, max-age=60" and an ETag, meaning each cart is revalidated frequently and only cached client-side for 60s.
Impact: For high read concurrency (many returning users), origin will still see frequent revalidation traffic and DB lookups; bandwidth/compute pressure may rise from many unique users.
Fix: Keep private semantics but extend TTL where safe or use conditional requests with s-maxage for edge caching of non-personalized parts (or separate cacheable product image/metadata from user-specific cart data).

--- INFO ---

[CDN-5] Cloudflare Images utilities and next/image loader present
File: src/lib/cloudflare-images.ts (L1-L300)
Evidence: Repo includes a cloudflareImageLoader, buildCloudflareImageUrl and helpers to produce variants and a custom loader for next/image.
Use INFO only: this is a positive signal — it enables efficient variant serving if components actually use the loader and CLOUD account config is present; misconfiguration (missing account hash) falls back to originals.
